# S525 — "finds nothing" and "matches nothing" mark a Check line as an empty-output check

A Check line worded "finds nothing", "matches nothing" or "returns nothing" is judged like "prints nothing" (adj 468): empty output with exit 0, or exit 1 from rg, grep or git grep, passes.
